en.Name: Ops-Core helmet cover (AOR2)
en.Description: A tactical helmet cover designed for Ops-Core high-cut ballistic helmets. Made from durable nylon with reinforced stitching and attachment points for cables, counterweights, and accessories. Features the AOR2 digital camouflage pattern optimized for temperate and coastal environments.

en.Name: Ops-Core helmet cover (Desert Tiger Stripe)
en.Description: A helmet cover made for Ops-Core high-cut ballistic helmets, constructed from rugged, abrasion-resistant fabric. Finished in the Desert Tiger Stripe pattern, providing effective concealment in arid, sandy terrain and broken scrub environments.

en.Name: Ops-Core helmet cover (Multicam Black)
en.Description: A high-durability helmet cover built for Ops-Core high-cut ballistic helmets. Produced from tear-resistant nylon with integrated cable management and hook-and-loop panels. Coated in the Multicam Black pattern, intended for law-enforcement and urban low-visibility operations.

en.Name: Ops-Core helmet cover (Multicam Tropic)
en.Description: A rugged nylon helmet cover designed for Ops-Core high-cut ballistic helmets. Includes reinforced seams, accessory mounting points, and Velcro paneling. Uses the Multicam Tropic camouflage pattern for improved concealment in lush, dense jungle and green woodland environments.
